text:
Total consideration per share of Company Common Stock comprises $15 in cash plus a number of Parent Common Stock shares equal to the Exchange Ratio (i.e., Merger Consideration consisting of cash and stock).
Merger Consideration components: - Per Share Cash Consideration: $15.00 per share. - Per Share Stock Consideration: number of Parent Common Stock equal to the Exchange Ratio. - Exchange Ratio: defined as (A) 0.5265 if the Parent Trading Price is at or below Floor Price; (B) 20 divided by the Parent Trading Price if the Parent Trading Price is greater than the Floor Price but less than the Ceiling Price; (C) 0.3326 if the Parent Trading Price is greater than or equal to the Ceiling Price. - Equity Award Exchange Ratio: the sum of (A) the Exchange Ratio and (B) the quotient, rounded to four decimal places, obtained by dividing (x) the Per Share Cash Consideration by (y) the Parent Trading Price. - Cash in lieu of fractional shares: cash payable in lieu of fractional shares. - Dividends and other distributions: dividends and other distributions payable in respect of shares of Parent Common Stock as described in Section 2.1(f). - CVRs: none described.
The Exchange Ratio is price-based: (A) 0.5265 per Company share if the Parent Trading Price is at or below the Floor Price; (B) the quotient obtained by dividing $20 by the Parent Trading Price if the price is above Floor Price but below Ceiling Price; (C) 0.3326 per Company share if the Parent Trading Price is at or above the Ceiling Price. For Merger Consideration, each share of Company Common Stock converts into cash of $15.00 and a number of Parent Common Stock shares equal to the Exchange Ratio, with the Equity Award Exchange Ratio equal to the Exchange Ratio plus the Per Share Cash Consideration divided by the Parent Trading Price.
